source.title: 10. Cardiovascular Disease and Risk Management: Standards of Care in Diabetes—2026
source.organization: American Diabetes Association Professional Practice Committee for Diabetes

schema_gaps: The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation atom kind.
The current LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated recommendation-strength/evidence-grade field; ADA grades are preserved as tags and within normalized recommendation statements.

The schema is primary-literature oriented, so trial outcomes summarized by the guideline were intentionally left as secondary-source narrative evidence rather than primary-study quantitative_result atoms.
limitations: Recommendation 10.14 crosses a PDF page/column boundary; its normalized statement was reconstructed from the two source-page fragments and anchored to S222–S223.
PDF text extraction introduced line-wrap artifacts; normalization removed extraction hyphenation without changing clinical meaning.
Underlying cited studies require separate primary-source extraction if primary-study atoms are needed.
